TanStack Start server function.description:
Define a function that runs only on the server and is callable from the client as an RPC. Requires createServerFn from @tanstack/react-start.

定义只在服务端执行、客户端可作为 RPC 调用的函数；需要 @tanstack/react-start 的 createServerFn。

TanStack Start server function with vali.description:
Validate the payload before the handler runs; the validator accepts any Standard Schema validator, such as a Zod schema. Requires createServerFn from @tanstack/react-start.

在 handler 执行前校验入参，validator 接受任何 Standard Schema 校验器，例如 Zod schema；需要 @tanstack/react-start 的 createServerFn。

TanStack Start server-only function.description:
Wrap a helper that must never reach the client bundle; calling it from the browser throws. Unlike a server function it is not an RPC. Requires createServerOnlyFn from @tanstack/react-start.

包裹绝不能进入客户端产物的工具函数，在浏览器中调用会抛错；它不是 RPC，与 server function 不同；需要 @tanstack/react-start 的 createServerOnlyFn。

TanStack Start isomorphic function.description:
Give one function a server implementation and a client implementation; each build keeps only its own. Requires createIsomorphicFn from @tanstack/react-start.

为同一个函数分别提供服务端与客户端实现，各自的产物只保留对应那份；需要 @tanstack/react-start 的 createIsomorphicFn。

TanStack Start useServerFn.description:
Call a server function from a component so redirects and not-found responses it throws are handled by the router. Requires useServerFn from @tanstack/react-start.

在组件中调用 server function，使其抛出的 redirect 与 not-found 由 router 接管；需要 @tanstack/react-start 的 useServerFn。

TanStack Start middleware.description:
Share work across server functions; what next receives as context is merged into the handler's context. Requires createMiddleware from @tanstack/react-start.

在多个 server function 之间复用逻辑，传给 next 的 context 会并入 handler 的 context；需要 @tanstack/react-start 的 createMiddleware。
